summary.content:
Today's selection covers 44 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 5 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI executive sends internal memo: ‘The market is as competitive as I have ever seen it’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: CPUID Hacked to Serve Trojanized CPU-Z and HWMonitor Downloads
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 22 articles published in the last 24 hours
